purpose: Source-native gene-abundance screening; not calibrated cross-study differential expression
compatibility_basis: Linear transcript-per-million gene abundance; reject microarray proxies, CP10K, CPM proxies, nTPM, pTPM and gene-feature-count TPM
Current exact locus mapping; ambiguous duplicate vectors quarantined; protein-identical loci summed only in the same sample/context with all members measured
Pinned tumor matrices and per-sample quality selection from the existing source-scale registry
Complete 36-context combined nonreproductive normal anatomy panel, plus observed native-TPM normal immune and brain measurements

expression_bounds.target_maximum: max(tumor, adult reproductive, developmental) >= 1 and above every measured nonreproductive normal and Disposable value on the comparison scale.
expression_bounds.cap_scope: Each source scale separately; a screening convention, not a tolerance.

normal_statistic: Maximum of individual HPA tissue samples and supported context statistics: tissue/subregion means, GTEx v11 donor medians, and immune summaries including DICE third-highest TPM
limitations: Quantifier, library preparation and study effects are retained; the fold rule is a screening convention
A maximum of tissue summaries is not a maximum over every healthy donor
Other assay scales continue to enforce the existing shared normal screen independently
participant_identity: Shared sample_identities API joins curated case/donor mappings and documented TCGA, TARGET, MMRF and Treehouse identifiers. Every sample retains identity status, basis and references. Unresolved or conflicting identities support only the single-sample route.

individual_tissue_source.statistic: individual tissue sample; summed transcript TPM
individual_tissue_source.participant_identity: Not provided; sample identifiers are not assumed to be donor IDs

normal_library_qc.policy: Signatures are evaluated within each tissue. Testis signatures are expected in normal testis. Flags require adjudication; they never silently remove normal measurements from the denominator. Flagged samples cannot provide positive reproductive evidence.

positive_observations: CA: individual passing tumor; RA: individual reproductive tissue or supported embryo-by-lineage mean. Qualitative protein and incompatible RNA scales cannot bypass the fold.
witness_tables: All tenfold witnesses are exported; tumor table also retains up to six weaker above-normal examples per protein. Filter single_sample_pass for qualifying counts. Unknown donor identity is never claimed independent.
